mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 6.0% indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1700) signals an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 285), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand that reduces the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST declines by >0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 285, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth (YoY) is at least 1.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) signals an economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
